result.summary: The page appears to render correctly overall. This is a food delivery app home screen with clear layout and no significant visual defects. Only a minor styling inconsistency was noted.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are inconsistent between cards. The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a white heart on a light circular background, while the pizza card below uses a white heart on a dark circular background, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and color treatment across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.
